notes.title: Get the Development Book & Soundtrack DLC!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that exclusive DLC for [b][i]Reaplaced [/i][/b]is now available:

[h2]Award-Winning Soundtrack [/h2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631660/Reaplaced_Soundtrack/

The soundtrack contains 7 songs (~15 minutes total) which you can preview on its store page.

[h2]70+ Page Development Book [/h2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631730/Reaplaced_Development_Book/

In the DevBook PDF, you'll learn tips and tricks from the creators of [i]Detective Butler[/i], [i]Methods[/i], [i]SoulSet[/i], and [i]Game of Fourtune[/i] as we worked together to create [i]Reaplaced [/i]within 30 days!

[i]All proceeds from the DLCs will be reinvested back into the [b][i]Mystery Gamedev[/i][/b] community![/i]

Our mission is to create the #1 community for fans and developers of mystery-themed video games.

If you haven't already, feel free to [url=https://mysterygamedev.com/discord]join us on Discord[/url] and [url=https://mysterygamedev.com/news]subscribe to our newsletter,[/url] where we provide tools and resources for aspiring mystery game developers.

Thank you for your support, and Happy Halloween!
